explanation: Matches the question on erdosproblems.com/168 whether lim F(N)/N is irrational, where F(N) is the largest subset of [1,N] with no n, 2n, 3n. The limit is written as a limsup, which coincides with the limit since it exists (Graham–Spencer–Witsenhausen), and the sequence is bounded in [0,1]. Stated affirmatively as open.
